baseline: Unmodified current AnonymousAuditCircuit with InputClass4;16outputs instantiated experimentally. audit.go change only retains already-derived tx public bytes and appends16outputshape.2/4/8 compiled counts match committed pins.
simplified: Proves sender prefix83+33R and recipient prefix74 using X25519 then existing delivered Poseidon CRDS+CRING/adt1 audit stream AES256CTR schedule. CRDS includes packed DH,taggedtransaction viewing public key,taggedrecipient viewing key,salt,slot index,first nullifier. Sender bundle uses output_count as slot index. No spent-input hashes/prefixes are computed or disclosed. Auditor disclosure retains only output nullifier public keys plus packed32-byte sender viewing u.
assumptions: all remaining output slots real recipients
one real input, three dummy input slots; compiler InputClass4
preserves current same-owner input restriction; does not implement desired mixed-owner/PDA redesign
sender owner key is matched to input0 owner identity; all inputs share it by current constraints
sender viewing public key and recipient viewing key list remain hidden from public observers
raw mint32 maps to committed asset field through hash_bytes_32
16outputs are an experimental extension, unsupported by production anonymous catalog
byte_scope: encryption payload bytes in compact custom-ring frame including transaction viewing u32,salt16,output tags/body lengths,sender tag/body length,auditor ephemeral u32,sealed txsecret32,disclosure fields
excludes output commitment hashes, proofs,input nullifiers,interface transfers,other instruction header fields,and Solana transaction overhead
byte model matches prior table convention with1realinput; compiled inputclass4supports1..4actualinputs
retained envelope means32B sealed transaction secret plus32B ephemeral u remain present
Poseidon disclosure field count rounds packed byteblocks into31Bchunks encoded32Bfield elements
limitations: Prototype uses the existing delivered Poseidon KDF for anonymous bodies. This changes ciphertext bytes and requires corresponding SDK/protocol changes; it is not compatible with current anonymous HKDF ciphertexts. Plaintext layouts and lengths are unchanged.
full proofs/setup/timings were not generated; compiled systems solved honest witnesses for each shape
audit guarantees changed: simplified version removes note-level input traceability while preserving proven sender/output identity and values
experimental statement and encoding require protocol/code/key changes before deployment
Constraint counts are exact for this experimental circuit, not a lower bound over all possible designs.
